**On-call handoff — gateway 503s**

**Root cause:** `dep-4471` (gateway, deployed by a.novak, `02:12:00Z`–`02:14:00Z`) flipped `gateway.pool.perRequest` from `false` to `true`. Right after, the connection pool pinned at 20/20 in use and stayed there, so new requests queued and timed out into 503s. Every 503 line pairs with `ERR_POOL_EXHAUSTED acquiring connection from pool (size 20, in_use 20, waiting N)`, and N climbs steadily, up to 74 by the end of the log.

**Impact window:** starts `2026-03-14T02:14:18.972Z` (first 503, `req-07401` on `/v1/cart`). Still ongoing as of the last log line, `2026-03-14T03:59:27.974Z`. No recovery in the log, 530 pool-exhaustion errors total.

**Scope:** gateway only. `logs/worker.log` shows zero errors in this window, just one unrelated slow-query warning tagged `OPS-2210`.

**Action:** roll back `dep-4471` on the gateway.
